# hg cron

**What this page tells you:** every `hg cron` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The agent's scheduler surface - hermes wrapped natively, eve projected read-only.

## Synopsis

```text
hg cron list [flags]
hg cron show <job> [flags]
hg cron history [<job>] [flags]
hg cron run <job> [flags]
hg cron enable <job> [flags]
hg cron disable <job> [flags]
```

## Description

Every cron verb acts on ONE profile's job registry — a fleet-wide `cron run` would be a different, more dangerous verb than the one an operator is asking for. With more than one profile deployed, `--profile` is required. On an Eve profile, `list|show|history` project the declared `agent/schedules/`; the mutating verbs refuse - Eve compiles schedules at build (`hg agent prove`, leg EVE015).

## `hg cron list`

```text
hg cron list [flags]
```

The profile's cron jobs (paused jobs included).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
